app.name: Medvya
consent.script: With your permission, Medvya will record our conversation today to help me write your medical notes. Only your care team can access it. You can say no or ask me to stop at any time, and your care will not change.
consent.declined: No recording for this visit. You can write the note manually.
msg.delivered: Delivered — this does not complete the task
ai.unavailable: AI drafting is unavailable right now. Your recording is saved.
err.403: You don’t have access to this facility.
push.generic: New update from {clinic}. Open Medvya to view.
state.sessionExpired.title: Session expired
state.sessionExpired.body: Your unsaved draft is kept on this device. Sign in again to continue; you will be asked to confirm the patient.
state.noAccess.body: You are signed in to {facility}. This record belongs to another facility.
state.notFound.title: Page not found
state.notFound.body: The link may be old. Nothing has been changed.
state.offline.title: You are offline
state.offline.body: Recording continues to the encrypted device buffer. Notes and orders will save when you reconnect.
session.failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again, or ask your clinic admin if it keeps happening.
shell.comingInPhase: This screen arrives in phase {phase}. There is nothing to do here yet.
shell.noScreens.title: Nothing to show yet
shell.noScreens.body: No screens are switched on for your role at this facility. Ask your practice admin if you expected access.
shell.chooseFacility.title: Choose where you are working today
shell.chooseFacility.body: Signed in as {name}. No facility is selected yet. Choosing a facility is being added; until then, ask your practice admin if you need access.
schedule.error.title: The schedule could not be loaded
schedule.error.body: Nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
schedule.offline: You are offline. The schedule loads when you reconnect.
schedule.forbidden.body: Ask your practice admin for access to this facility's schedule.
schedule.empty.title: No doctors or resources here yet
schedule.empty.body: Add a doctor, or a resource such as a procedure room, in Practice settings to see their calendar.
